subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept the persisted announceLastRun marker and the "killed but non-running" reconciliation for interrupted subagent announce delivery turns?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it intentionally changes persisted session recovery semantics and a tool-execution boundary, which are maintainer-owned compatibility/security decisions under the repository policy.

options.title: Accept the guarded recovery semantics
options.body: Merge after maintainer signoff, keeping the shared classifier, disableTools propagation, and announceLastRun recovery marker as the canonical behavior.

options.title: Change the terminal-state choice first
options.body: Ask the author to keep the same detection/tool isolation but use a different non-running session status if "killed" is not the desired user-visible lifecycle state.

options.title: Pause for recovery model redesign
options.body: Hold or close this PR only if maintainers want a broader restart-recovery state model instead of a narrow announce-delivery marker.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded recovery semantics
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer signoff, keeping the shared classifier, disableTools propagation, and announceLastRun recovery marker as the canonical behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman is the clearest recent owner signal for restart recovery lifecycle seams and adjacent Codex message/tool policy touched by this PR.
